title: HShaggy Zesty Almond Tagine
description: A tangy and shaggy one-pot Portuguese dish featuring ground almonds, a score-fat blend with low-fat-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add sliced onions and sauté until translucent.
Add diced bell peppers, garlic cloves, thyme, salt, and pepper. Sauté for about 2 minutes.
Increase heat to high, add ground almonds and stir well. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until fragrant.
Stir in olive tapenade and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly to combine all ingredients.
Transfer the mixture into a baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes.
Add turkey sausage pieces evenly distributed over the almond mix. Continue baking for another 10-12 minutes or until the sausage is fully cooked and the almonds are golden brown.
Remove from heat, let it sit for about 5 minutes before serving.
